senses.sense_definition: A town in the borough of Croydon, Greater London, England.

examples.text: The commuter train stops at <w>Purley</w> before continuing into central London.
Many people choose to reside in <w>Purley</w> because of its pleasant residential areas.

senses.sense_definition: A village and civil parish in Berkshire, England, formally known as Purley on Thames.

examples.text: We walked along the river path that runs directly past <w>Purley</w> in Berkshire.
Older regional maps frequently labeled the village simply as <w>Purley</w>.

senses.sense_definition: An unincorporated community in Caswell County, North Carolina, United States.

examples.text: They spent the summer visiting family in rural <w>Purley</w>, North Carolina.
The rural route through <w>Purley</w> offers views of quiet farmland.

senses.sense_definition: An unincorporated community in Franklin County, Texas, United States.

examples.text: Driving east through Texas, we passed by the small community of <w>Purley</w>.
Local historians documented early settlements established around <w>Purley</w> in Franklin County.
